content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Travel marketplace for short-term stays and experiences; it does not finance consumer purchases of merchandise through lease-to-own."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Buys and collects charged-off consumer debt; it does not provide lease-to-own payment plans for retail goods."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace for independent sellers' crafts and resale goods; it does not lease merchandise to consumers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate and government tenants; no consumer leasing of goods."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Franchisor of blue-collar staffing offices earning royalties; it places workers rather than financing consumer purchases."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Freight transportation and logistics for shippers; a different business serving B2B customers with no consumer lease financing."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; no consumer lease-to-own financing or merchandise."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and risk consulting earning commissions; it does not provide lease-to-own consumer financing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates a hotel and apartment rentals plus securities investments; the hospitality and housing business differs from lease-to-own."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Lease-to-own financing for consumers with limited credit, sold through partner merchants and online checkout, matching the target's model."}]}
